saw_lines: Nobody buys a used bike from a photo alone. Buyers test ride, check the frame and haggle before they commit.
So the sale is won or lost in the ad, where a buyer decides if the bike is worth a visit.
7 of your 14 copy ads open on the same 200'000 buyers line, so run three new openers from your FAQ, starting with how much is my bike worth.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 30 Oct 2026
points: 7 of 14 copy ads open on the same 200'000 buyers line, so one message keeps reaching the same people. Run three new openers from your FAQ on the bike worth question, the handover and choosing the right bike.

0 of your 28 ads are video, so a buyer cannot see a used bike move before clicking. Shoot three clips of a Cube Agree or Focus Sam being ridden, plus one seller handover, and test each against your best still.

7 of your 14 copy ads repeat one copy, so the same words reach the same buyers. Keep the body, rewrite the opening line and swap the creative. Sellers get a price check opener, buyers get a test ride opener.

None of your 28 ads shows a proof number, so a new buyer or seller has nothing concrete to trust upfront. Collect one real figure, such as reviews or handovers completed, and lead with it on the next creative.

ads_1: Fresh openers from your FAQ, tested against the 200'000 buyers opener
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube
